description: Download one subtitle file by file_id and return its text (or a temporary link), with optional format conversion, FPS conversion or time shift. Each call uses one download from the user's daily OpenSubtitles quota, so pick the file with search_subtitles first; the result reports the remaining quota.

delivery.description: content = return the subtitle text; link = return only a temporary download URL (for large files or saving to disk)

in_fps.description: Frame rate the subtitle was timed for (use with out_fps)

out_fps.description: Frame rate of your video (use with in_fps)

sub_format.description: Convert to this format. Omit to keep the original (usually srt).

timeshift.description: Shift all cues by this many seconds, e.g. 2.5 or -1

name: download_subtitle

link.description: Temporary download URL (valid for a few hours)

requests.description: Downloads used in the current period

title: Download subtitle
